S4.name: Scene 4: The Queen of Hearts' Rose Garden

cues.raw_text: [panicked] Oh, dear! Oh, dear! I shall be too late!
cues.clean_text: Oh, dear! Oh, dear! I shall be too late!
cues.subtitle_text: WHITE RABBIT: Oh, dear! Oh, dear! I shall be too late!

cues.raw_text: [amazed] A rabbit wearing a waistcoat and carrying a watch? How curious! [excitedly] Oh wait! Mr. Rabbit! Where are you going? What's the hurry?
cues.clean_text: A rabbit wearing a waistcoat and carrying a watch? How curious! Oh wait! Mr. Rabbit! Where are you going? What's the hurry?
cues.subtitle_text: ALICE: A rabbit wearing a waistcoat and carrying a watch? How curious! Oh wait! Mr. Rabbit! Where are you going? What's the hurry?

cues.raw_text: [rushed] The Queen will be furious if I don't reach the palace!
cues.clean_text: The Queen will be furious if I don't reach the palace!
cues.subtitle_text: WHITE RABBIT: The Queen will be furious if I don't reach the palace!

cues.raw_text: [mischievously] Welcome to Wonderland, little girl! Looking for someone?
cues.clean_text: Welcome to Wonderland, little girl! Looking for someone?
cues.subtitle_text: CHESHIRE CAT: Welcome to Wonderland, little girl! Looking for someone?

cues.raw_text: I'm looking for my way home.
cues.clean_text: I'm looking for my way home.
cues.subtitle_text: ALICE: I'm looking for my way home.

cues.raw_text: [chuckles] That depends on where you want to go! [mischievously] We're all mad here!
cues.clean_text: That depends on where you want to go! We're all mad here!
cues.subtitle_text: CHESHIRE CAT: That depends on where you want to go! We're all mad here!

cues.raw_text: Everybody seems so strange here!
cues.clean_text: Everybody seems so strange here!
cues.subtitle_text: ALICE: Everybody seems so strange here!

cues.raw_text: [playfully] Follow the music to the tea party!
cues.clean_text: Follow the music to the tea party!
cues.subtitle_text: CHESHIRE CAT: Follow the music to the tea party!

cues.raw_text: [sings] Twinkle, twinkle, little bat...
cues.clean_text: Twinkle, twinkle, little bat...
cues.subtitle_text: DORMOUSE: Twinkle, twinkle, little bat...

cues.raw_text: [excitedly] No room! No room! [playfully] Welcome to our tea party!
cues.clean_text: No room! No room! Welcome to our tea party!
cues.subtitle_text: MAD HATTER: No room! No room! Welcome to our tea party!

cues.raw_text: But there's plenty of room!
cues.clean_text: But there's plenty of room!
cues.subtitle_text: ALICE: But there's plenty of room!

cues.raw_text: [playfully] Have some tea! Or perhaps some imaginary wine!
cues.clean_text: Have some tea! Or perhaps some imaginary wine!
cues.subtitle_text: MARCH HARE: Have some tea! Or perhaps some imaginary wine!

cues.raw_text: Why is this tea party so strange?
cues.clean_text: Why is this tea party so strange?
cues.subtitle_text: ALICE: Why is this tea party so strange?

cues.raw_text: Because in Wonderland, nothing makes sense!
cues.clean_text: Because in Wonderland, nothing makes sense!
cues.subtitle_text: MAD HATTER: Because in Wonderland, nothing makes sense!

cues.raw_text: [sleepily] Please stop! I'm trying to sleep!
cues.clean_text: Please stop! I'm trying to sleep!
cues.subtitle_text: DORMOUSE: Please stop! I'm trying to sleep!

cues.raw_text: Don't you ever wake up?
cues.clean_text: Don't you ever wake up?
cues.subtitle_text: ALICE: Don't you ever wake up?

cues.raw_text: Only when someone mentions cake!
cues.clean_text: Only when someone mentions cake!
cues.subtitle_text: DORMOUSE: Only when someone mentions cake!

cues.raw_text: [playfully] Wake up, Dormouse! It's tea time!
cues.clean_text: Wake up, Dormouse! It's tea time!
cues.subtitle_text: MARCH HARE: Wake up, Dormouse! It's tea time!

cues.raw_text: [yawn] Oh! Then I'm wide awake!
cues.clean_text: Oh! Then I'm wide awake!
cues.subtitle_text: DORMOUSE: Oh! Then I'm wide awake!

cues.raw_text: [furious] Who dares enter my garden? Off with their heads!
cues.clean_text: Who dares enter my garden? Off with their heads!
cues.subtitle_text: RED QUEEN: Who dares enter my garden? Off with their heads!

cues.raw_text: Why are you so angry?
cues.clean_text: Why are you so angry?
cues.subtitle_text: ALICE: Why are you so angry?

cues.raw_text: [roaring] How dare you question the Queen of Hearts!
cues.clean_text: How dare you question the Queen of Hearts!
cues.subtitle_text: RED QUEEN: How dare you question the Queen of Hearts!

cues.raw_text: [stiffly] Yes, Your Majesty! Nobody questions the Queen of Hearts!
cues.clean_text: Yes, Your Majesty! Nobody questions the Queen of Hearts!
cues.subtitle_text: CARD SOLDIER: Yes, Your Majesty! Nobody questions the Queen of Hearts!

cues.raw_text: Do you always follow orders without thinking?
cues.clean_text: Do you always follow orders without thinking?
cues.subtitle_text: ALICE: Do you always follow orders without thinking?

cues.raw_text: [defensive] Well, I'm a soldier, not a thinker!
cues.clean_text: Well, I'm a soldier, not a thinker!
cues.subtitle_text: CARD SOLDIER: Well, I'm a soldier, not a thinker!

cues.raw_text: [shouting] Enough talking! Seize her immediately!
cues.clean_text: Enough talking! Seize her immediately!
cues.subtitle_text: RED QUEEN: Enough talking! Seize her immediately!

cues.raw_text: [marching] Yes, Your Majesty!
cues.clean_text: Yes, Your Majesty!
cues.subtitle_text: CARD SOLDIER: Yes, Your Majesty!

cues.raw_text: [defiant] I'm not afraid of you! You're nothing but a pack of cards!
cues.clean_text: I'm not afraid of you! You're nothing but a pack of cards!
cues.subtitle_text: ALICE: I'm not afraid of you! You're nothing but a pack of cards!
